# `satl node` { #satl-node }

Manage swarm nodes

```console
$ satl node [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

`satl node` is a group: it always takes one of the subcommands below.

## `satl node ls` { #satl-node-ls }

List nodes in the swarm

```console
$ satl node ls [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-q, --quiet</code> | Only display IDs |

## `satl node ps` { #satl-node-ps }

List the tasks running on one or more nodes

```console
$ satl node ps [OPTIONS] [NODE]...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>[NODE]...</code> | Nodes whose tasks to list; defaults to this one, as docker does<br>Default: <code>self</code> |

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--no-trunc</code> | Don't truncate output |
| <code>-q, --quiet</code> | Only display task IDs |

## `satl node inspect` { #satl-node-inspect }

Display detailed information on one or more nodes

```console
$ satl node inspect [OPTIONS] <NODE>...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;NODE&gt;...</code> | Nodes to inspect; `self` means the node serving this request |

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--pretty</code> | Print the information in a human friendly format |

## `satl node update` { #satl-node-update }

Update a node

```console
$ satl node update [OPTIONS] <NODE>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;NODE&gt;</code> | The node to update |

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--label-add &lt;KEY=VALUE&gt;</code> | Add or update a node label (`key=value`) |
| <code>--label-rm &lt;KEY&gt;</code> | Remove a node label if it exists |
| <code>--availability &lt;STATE&gt;</code> | Availability of the node<br>Values: <code>active</code>, <code>pause</code>, <code>drain</code> |
| <code>--role &lt;ROLE&gt;</code> | Role of the node<br>Values: <code>worker</code>, <code>manager</code> |

## `satl node rm` { #satl-node-rm }

Remove one or more nodes from the swarm

```console
$ satl node rm [OPTIONS] <NODE>...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;NODE&gt;...</code> | Nodes to remove |

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-f, --force</code> | Force remove a node from the swarm |

## `satl node promote` { #satl-node-promote }

Promote one or more nodes to manager in the swarm

```console
$ satl node promote [OPTIONS] <NODE>...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;NODE&gt;...</code> | Nodes to promote or demote |

## `satl node demote` { #satl-node-demote }

Demote one or more nodes from manager in the swarm

```console
$ satl node demote [OPTIONS] <NODE>...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;NODE&gt;...</code> | Nodes to promote or demote |

## Global options { #global-options }

Accepted by every `satl` command.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--host &lt;URL&gt;</code> | Daemon socket to connect to (docker-style URL)<br>Default: <code>unix:///var/run/satl.sock</code><br>Environment: <code>DOCKER_HOST</code> |
| <code>-h, --help</code> | Print help |
| <code>-V, --version</code> | Print version |
